status_note: not a bug: the docs are stricter than the code, so a reader who follows them is safe, and the masking is pinned by Polars's own tests. The facts below record what the code does. Related: [#25457](https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/25457) (open) asks to clarify the same paragraph.
summary: The documentation of `pl.when` (https://docs.pola.rs/api/python/stable/reference/expressions/api/polars.when.html, py-polars/src/polars/functions/whenthen.py#L48-L51 and #L80 at py-2.1.0) says "Polars computes all expressions passed to `when-then-otherwise` in parallel and filters afterwards. This means each expression must be valid on its own" and "Note that `when-then` always executes all expressions."

An elementwise branch is evaluated with its input columns masked to NULL on the rows its condition excludes (crates/polars-expr/src/expressions/ternary.rs#L110-L203), on both engines, so a strict cast in such a branch does not raise there. Polars's own tests pin the masking (py-polars/tests/unit/functions/test_when_then.py#L916-L960). The masking has limits the docs could state: non-elementwise branches, branches under `group_by().agg` or `over`, and a subexpression that common-subexpression elimination hoists out of two branches (PL-6).
repro:
import polars as pl
pl.LazyFrame({"x": ["1", "a"]}).select(
    pl.when(pl.col("x") == "1").then(pl.col("x").cast(pl.Int64))
).collect().rows()
# [(1,), (None,)] on both engines; the docs predict an InvalidOperationError
handling: sverify relies on the masking for elementwise branches (polars-exec-when-eager) and on the facts' limits for the rest. The fix is in Polars's documentation: document the masking and its limits, or state that it is not guaranteed.
found_by: the Polars characterization reverse pass (2026-11-04): the docstrings and user guide at py-2.1.0 checked against each open fact

checked.note: Repro on both engines (POLARS_IDEAL_MORSEL_SIZE=64). Main at 35a2cb73: whenthen.py#L49 and #L80 keep the warning. Duplicate search for "when then docs computes all expressions": #25457 (open, related: an aggregation in a branch computed over all rows).
